description: This circular walk takes you around Marsworth Reservoir in the Hertfordshire village of Marsworth. The walk runs for a distance of about 3 miles, following waterside trails around the lake. On the way you can enjoy some lovely views over the water to the surrounding Hertfordshire countryside. The reservoir is part of the Tring Reservoirs so it's easy to extend your walk by visiting the other local lakes. The Grand Union Canal Walk also runs past the lake so you could pick this up and head further into the countryside.
